title: Implement input validation with Zod schemas
description: Define Zod schemas matching the task table: id (8-char hex), title (max 200), priority (1-4), type (improvement|problem|idea), state (todo|in-progress|developed), description, files (string array), origin (user|ai|user-assisted). Provide createTaskSchema (no id, auto-generated) and updateTaskSchema (partial, all optional except id).
